newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Low offer in Nepal diesel tender, $162.69, $163.44.
newsitem.headline: Low offer in Nepal diesel tender, $162.69, $163.44.

text.p: The best offers into state-owned Nepal Oil Corp's (NOC) gas oil import tender was made by a European major oil company and a Mediterranean trading firm, traders said on Wednesday.
The European major made the lowest offer for the first cargo to be delivered during August 11-20 at $162.69 per tonne, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Madras and Haldia on India's east coast.
The major's offer of the second cargo for August 21-31 delivery was $164.55 per tonne, c-and-f east coast.
The Mediterranean trader's offer for the second cargo was the lowest at $163.44 per tonne for the later delivery period, c-and-f east coast.
The trader offered the first cargo at $164.04 per tonne, c-and-f basis.
The tender to buy two 30,000-tonne cargoes of 0.5-percent sulphur gas oil closed on July 15 and offers will be valid until July 17.
In its last tender, Nepal purchased 30,000 tonnes of 0.5 percent sulphur gas oil from Shell Singapore at $185.73 per tonne for June 1-10 delivery, c-and-f Indian east coast.
